players.product: custom 2nm ASIC design for hyperscaler AI

quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (annual securities report): net sales JPY 200,834 million (up 6.5%); ordinary income JPY 11,756 million (down 53.2%) after foreign exchange losses; net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 8,733 million (down 55.4%); EBITDA JPY 29,256 million versus JPY 41,237 million the prior year (down 29.1%). NRE revenue was 19% of consolidated net sales in FY March 2026. The average exchange rate was JPY 150.8 to the US dollar, 1.8 yen stronger than the prior year.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 200,834 million (+6.5%); ordinary income JPY 11,756 million (-53.2%); net income JPY 8,733 million (-55.4%); EBITDA JPY 29,256 million (vs JPY 41,237 million); NRE 19% of net sales

quarterly_data.signal: Sales by region (classified by the customer-designated delivery destination), FY March 2026 versus FY March 2025: Asia JPY 91,631 million (vs JPY 64,475 million), of which China JPY 80,669 million (vs JPY 56,504 million); Japan JPY 74,041 million (vs JPY 84,073 million); Americas JPY 28,906 million (vs JPY 32,379 million), of which the U.S. JPY 22,099 million (vs JPY 30,066 million); Europe JPY 6,256 million (vs JPY 7,608 million).
quarterly_data.figure: China JPY 80,669 million (vs JPY 56,504 million); Japan JPY 74,041 million (vs JPY 84,073 million); U.S. JPY 22,099 million (vs JPY 30,066 million)

quarterly_data.signal: Mass-production ramp: operating cash flow fell to JPY 7,693 million (prior year JPY 31,866 million) mainly because gross profit fell as relatively low-margin new products entered mass production while inventory purchases rose with the start of mass production; free cash flow was minus JPY 15,191 million. Investment spending was JPY 14,855 million on property, plant and equipment (reticles, test boards and evaluation equipment for product development of won design wins) and JPY 8,052 million on intangibles such as IP macros. Reticles and test boards held at contract manufacturers and other sites (Taipei, Taiwan and others) had a book value of JPY 12,848 million at March 31, 2026; the company plans no significant new facilities or retirements.
quarterly_data.figure: Operating cash flow JPY 7,693 million (vs JPY 31,866 million); PP&E spending JPY 14,855 million; intangibles JPY 8,052 million; reticles/test boards at contract manufacturers JPY 12,848 million

quarterly_data.signal: Socionext recognised an impairment loss of JPY 1,531 million on technology assets (mainly IP) held as SoC development assets for a specific customer in the automotive field, after that customer decided to withdraw from the business; the assets cannot be used for other products and their recoverable value was set to zero.
quarterly_data.figure: Impairment loss JPY 1,531 million (technology assets, automotive customer exit)

quarterly_data.signal: Management priorities: annual design wins were around JPY 110 billion in FY March 2018 and FY March 2019 before the structural reform and around JPY 300 billion from FY March 2023; management states the design win balance lets it foresee sales trends through FY March 2028 to some extent, but more design wins are needed for sustained growth from FY March 2028 onward, to be won in a balanced way across focus areas led by Data Center & Networking and Automotive, with Industrial (FA and measuring equipment) positioned as a new focus area. It plans to expand investment in 2 nm and 1.4 nm development linked to chiplets, co-packaged optics (CPO) for optical data transmission, 3D/5.5D advanced packaging, AI built into its SoC design process and engineer hiring in the U.S. and India; during the year it set up engineering teams for AI-processing system implementation and for mass-production technology and quality within its Global Leading Group. To raise operating income it targets better manufacturing gross margin, better development profitability and SG&A control.
quarterly_data.figure: Design wins ~JPY 110 billion (FY March 2018-2019) to ~JPY 300 billion (from FY March 2023)
